items.title: Shelly Berg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Monk' (e.g., 'Thank you, Monk'), indicating the interviewer's surname is Monk, not that the interviewee is referring to Thelonious Monk.
